title: EXTENDING ACTIVATION STEERING TO BROAD SKILLS AND MULTIPLE BEHAVIOURS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's matching score on binary (yes/no or A/B) multiple-choice questions designed to elicit anti-immigration stances and political sycophancy, utilizing datasets from Perez et al. (2022).
